method.description: Study when a fitted regression, evaluated at all-treated and all-control assignments, estimates finite-population GATE accurately. The candidate direction is ridge regression with an unpenalized intercept, own treatment, covariates, one-hop treated-neighbor fraction, fixed hinge bases and treatment-exposure interactions. Compare it with difference-in-means, own-treatment regression and linear one-hop regression. Test whether exposure adequacy, support near the endpoint interventions, interference strength and graph structure explain changes in bias and RMSE. Explicitly include misspecified two-hop interference, nonlinear interference and cluster assignment. This is a bounded simulation and semi-synthetic study, not a claim of universal superiority, identification under arbitrary interference, or novelty of regression adjustment itself. Favorable, unfavorable and inconclusive comparisons are all legitimate outcomes; publication requires uncertainty and limitations, not a positive effect. Search correctness means scientific-evaluation integrity and matched behavioral controls, not superiority. Final correctness independently means completed sealed integrity/control checks, not automatic publication. Fixed inputs, DGPs, score weights, finite penalties, explicit RPC operation counts and timing reservations are recorded in own-plane manifests. No feedback-dependence or changed-state gate applies to this nonadaptive regression task.

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness only: at most three complete production search evaluations, one per idea attempt. Eligibility requires search correct=true, not baseline improvement or significance. Rank eligible candidates by combined_score descending; exact ties prefer earliest completed evaluation, then lexicographic frozen source SHA-256. Freeze before sealed final. Scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim assessment are separate. Ordered case-major production primary episodes: search SBM/BA/WS x M0..M5 x eight seeds, then constant and permutation each x eight seeds (160); final SBM/BA/WS/Stanford3 x M0..M5 x 24 seeds, then constant/permutation each x 24 (624). Exactly one trailing replay of the first selected seed is always performed after each declared primary sequence; its reset is included in every complete ordered global reset array, including smoke and across all connections. Smoke primary sequence is M0,M2,constant,permutation on first seed, then same sole replay (five episodes total). RPC table per episode: reset 1 + ingest at most 8 + fit 1 + predict 1 =11; first/last ingest performs setup/commit, no hidden transfer calls. Search 161*11=1771; final 625*11=6875; smoke 5*11=55. All controls and replay retain fixed finite failure slots. Missing or unsuccessful controls make qualification infeasible. No candidate state flags or internal counters are scientific evidence.

search_proxies.name: small_synthetic_search
search_proxies.preserves: Six DGPs, three synthetic graph families, paired seed experiments, endpoint estimand, actual baselines and matched constant/permutation/reset behavior, finite penalties and fixed hierarchy.
search_proxies.omits: Larger 4096-node fresh synthetic graphs, full 11586-node Stanford3, 24 sealed seeds, and final external-validity assessment. Search has 1024 nodes and eight seeds; search feedback never contains final values.

search_visible: Public scientific question, allowed starting literature and access restrictions; documented plane-independent handle protocol, permitted input semantics and finite resource ceilings; synthetic search definitions and evaluator-computed search scalar metrics/correctness plus permitted search diagnostics.

Candidate receives only its current episode's topology, covariates, realized assignment and observed experimental outcomes, permitted prediction assignments and public fitting configuration. Search-visible artifacts must not embed concrete final seeds, final manifests, final-seed constants, final assets or seed-to-workload mappings.

At most three idea cycles and one production candidate evaluation per attempt, three total. Each evaluation contains the entire declared search plan. Use deterministic eligibility, combined_score ranking and tie policy above; freeze the selected eligible source/configuration before final access. Wiring smoke cannot become extra scored candidate selection.
final_sealed: Final concrete seeds and split manifests, final synthetic graph instances and observations, selected public-graph resource copy and all unobserved potential outcomes/true GATE values remain evaluator-owned until freeze; reveal only the permitted current-episode observations through RPC.

Final baseline outputs, per-episode errors, scores, correctness, control judgments, uncertainty calculations, endpoint targets and claim assessment never enter candidate requests or search feedback. Final evidence is released only for post-freeze assessment/reporting, not candidate tuning or selection.

Privileged evaluator source/manifests/design/contract may record the final seed transcript; they are not candidate-visible starter material. Cross-role resource enforcement and allocation evidence are harness-owned; handle has no memory, telemetry or peer-resource accessor.

required_evidence: A completed paper PDF and LaTeX source using the latest official template of one chosen allowed conference, with verified current main-text page limit and required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, real consulted related work, method, experimental design, results, discussion, limitations and references. Publication quality/novelty review is separate from search eligibility and final operational correct.

Independent derivation of the finite-population endpoint estimand, linear correctly specified plug-in behavior and the role of unsupported extrapolation or omitted exposure terms. State testable hypotheses and interference/graph/design scope before scoring; distinguish model-dependent extrapolation from nonparametric identification and conditional public-topology results from general platform claims.

Actual reproducible completed-run records for all scientific cases, baselines, controls and the sole replay, including failures, abandoned candidates and budget-limited omissions. Provide paired seed-block uncertainty for bias/RMSE and baseline differences, per-family/mechanism tables, exposure-support/conditioning diagnostics, uncapped tails and clipping frequency. With only eight search and 24 final seeds per case, report Monte Carlo limitations and avoid node-independent standard errors. Do not fabricate numerical results, confidence intervals, launches, checkpoints or completed production validation.

Evaluator-owned raw archive and normalized graph/example digests, source/row provenance, normalization rules fixed before splitting/features, randomization/generator seeds and nonoverlapping search/final split manifests. Show content-level cross-plane intersection checks, including different-ID duplicates and relabeling provenance. Record the Stanford3 supplied revision verification and applicable license/attribution; shared immutable code is not a held-out data violation.

A frozen candidate/source/dependency digest and selection record showing at most three production search evaluations, each from its declared complete plan, eligibility independent of baseline superiority, combined_score ranking and deterministic tie handling before final access. Record that final results were not used for tuning or additional candidate evaluations.

Scaffold and validation must provide standard contract provenance, exact serialized maximum-size request/response measurements including JSON/base64/envelope/framing, strict sub-64-MiB checks, candidate-owned in-memory chunk handling and a complete RPC budget derivation. Validate the exact production and smoke reset arrays against every case-seed episode globally across connections. Retain actual transport-count and reset evidence; no shared-path RPC or private-target leakage is permissible.

Offline empty-HOME dependency validation and same-path 120-second smoke evidence for both planes, followed separately by actual full-production completion/failure evidence under enforced wall, aggregate all-thread CPU, memory and broker limits. Identify candidate objective evaluations, ridge-grid/solver iterations and reported internal counts as advisory unless independently counted by a trusted service; never present them as enforced internal compute caps. Smoke cannot attest full workload completion. No cross-role telemetry access is assumed.

Evaluator-owned negative-control evidence must show matched inputs/budgets, actual candidate fit and prediction execution, expected constant/zero contrast behavior, effective nonidentity permutation/equivariance and exactly one trailing reset replay. Null copy/constant baselines cannot stand in for the claimed method. Missing or failed controls and cases retain their predeclared finite worst-case contributions and original weights; a vacuous permutation yields no causal conclusion.

Complete reproducibility instructions with environment versions, offline installation approach, data acquisition/version/license, seeds, commands and measured eventual runtimes, plus a trace from every reported table/figure to actual run outputs and its generating code. Later scaffold additions beyond standard files require concrete task-relative paths and actual SHA-256 provenance with contract resynchronization. The week-long project limit includes implementation, no more than 2700 seconds of production search, 7200 seconds of final evaluation, analysis and writing; no unbudgeted extra candidate campaign is assumed.

Respect the canonical prohibition on the unnamed prior paper and all mirrors, summaries, code, discussion or follow-on pages about it. Do not infer its identity or search for its title/authors/results. Use only allowed starting references actually consulted and unrelated permitted material. Restrict asset acquisition to the supplied data URL; if prohibited content is accidentally encountered, stop immediately and record where, what and how much was seen in reproducibility notes. Missing referenced deliverable/resources/data sidecars are not supplied inputs; the requirements embedded in task.md are authoritative, and no sidecar contents or hidden harness behavior are presumed.

Contract reset arrays enumerate the entire ordered invocation, including the sole trailing deterministic replay: 161 search production resets, 625 final production resets and five resets in each smoke profile. Validate all four arrays against the executable case-major episode plans globally across connections; reconnections and process restarts never restart the transcript.

This scaffold is an operational test, not an automated conference review or proof of model internals. Full research PDF and LaTeX, latest official conference template/checklist, independent derivations, actually consulted permitted citations, paired seed-block uncertainty, uncapped tails and every figure/table reproduction remain required paper-stage work. No positive comparative threshold is authorized.

Low-level graph-cluster definition is deterministic balanced BFS over actual topology, not an optimized published design. M4 is length-two walk exposure including backtracking, not a unique-distance-two mean. Relabel-invariant multiset fingerprints conservatively reject possible graph overlap and raw row hashes exclude IDs. Frozen manifests document these scope limitations.

Linux native smoke requires functioning Landlock ABI 3 and libseccomp.so.2; CPython 3.11/3.12 wheels are pinned. No Python/CUDA/driver entries are pip packages. Empty-HOME local-data execution and bounded native file/network isolation are validated; actual production broker/container closure remains harness-owned.
